native.emptyBody: New activity will appear here. Pull down to refresh.
native.offline: Unable to reach the server. Your session is saved. Try again when connected.
native.permission: Allow camera or microphone access in Settings to continue.
native.pushPending: In-app notifications are available. Native push delivery awaits server APNs support.
native.nfcUnavailable: NFC is available on a supported physical iPhone. You can use QR or search by name.
native.nfcFailure: The card could not be completed. Keep the card still and try again. No success was reported to the server.
native.retryReport: Card written. Retry reporting to the server without writing again.
native.confirmName: Does the printed card show this name?
native.nfcPrompt: Hold the card near the top of your iPhone.
native.expired: Expired. Refresh to get a new code.
native.mediaTooLarge: This file is too large. Capture a smaller file and try again.
native.accessLost: Access to this conversation has ended.
native.hqWeb: Manage this in the HQ dashboard
native.captured: Screen recording hides this community. Screenshots are reported to the crew.
ux.card.eventClosed: Check-in is not open for this event. Return to the event for its latest status.
ux.events.staffAccess: Event management is available in Admin mode. Open Account to enable it. A member profile is required for the personal event journey.
ux.workspace.enableAdmin: Enable Admin mode in Account to use this workspace.
ux.card.heading: KTM — Member card
ux.card.digitalHint: Show your QR to crew for check-in. Digital access is separate from physical card preparation.
ux.card.physicalNext.NOT_PRINTED: Your card has not entered a print batch yet. Check here for preparation updates.
ux.card.physicalNext.IN_BATCH: Your card is in a print batch. No collection is needed yet.
ux.card.physicalNext.SENT_TO_VENDOR: Printing is in progress. Wait for the next preparation update.
ux.card.physicalNext.RECEIVED_HQ: HQ is preparing your card before handover.
ux.card.physicalNext.ENCODED: Encoding is complete. Crew will confirm delivery and collection; this status does not confirm shipment.
ux.card.physicalNext.DELIVERED: Your physical card has been handed over. Contact crew if it is lost or damaged.
ux.card.physicalNext.REVOKED: Contact crew for replacement and any required payment follow-up. Digital readiness is shown separately above.
ux.card.a11y: Member card for {name}. Favorite drink: {drink}. Quote of the day: {quote}.
ux.events.noNationalBody: No upcoming events are published in active cities yet. Past events remain below.
ux.events.noCityBody: No upcoming events are published in {city} yet. Browse other cities or see past events below.
ux.events.xpInWallet: Check your XP wallet for the confirmed award. Bonus claims are reviewed separately.
ux.events.notAttended: No check-in was recorded for this event.
ux.events.notCheckedIn: You have not checked in yet.
ux.events.waitingCrew: Waiting for crew to confirm check-in
ux.events.endedControls: Check-in has ended. Review attendance or complete the recap.
ux.events.publishConfirm: Make this event visible to members? This does not open check-in.
ux.events.openEarlyHint: Opening early lets crew record attendance immediately and changes the planned opening time to now. Check-in closes at {time}.
ux.events.openHint: Crew can record attendance until {time}. Existing attendance is kept.
ux.journey.title: Your next steps
ux.journey.activeMember: An active member profile is required to continue this journey.
ux.journey.posterPending: Poster sharing is being prepared. You can continue for now; no XP is awarded for this step yet.
ux.journey.posterEnded: This event has ended. Continue to review your attendance.
ux.journey.reservationEnded: Reservations are closed for this event.
ux.journey.reservationBonus: Reserve a table or sofa if needed. Eligible reservation bonus XP is confirmed through the claim review process.
ux.journey.visitingAccess: This event is outside your home city. Request visiting-city attendance access for this event before checking in.
ux.journey.checkInWait: Check-in is not open. Planned opening: {time}.
ux.wallet.chooseEvent: Choose the event before viewing eligible rewards or entering its draw.
ux.workspace.title: Event workspace
ux.editor.publishHint: Published events are visible to members. Drafts stay hidden. Publication and opening check-in are separate actions.
ux.scan.ended: This event has ended. Scanning is closed; attendance and recap are available in its workspace.
ux.scan.notOpen: Check-in is not open for this event. Manage the event to review its window or open check-in.
ux.scan.chooseToOpen: Choose an upcoming event below to review its check-in window and open check-in. Ended events cannot receive new scans.
ux.camera.explain: Camera access is needed to read a QR code. Allow access when you are ready to scan.
ux.camera.denied: Camera access is off. Open Settings to enable the camera, then return to scan.
ux.operations.eventUnavailable: This event is unavailable in your current scope. Return to Events to choose an authorized event.
ux.reward.eligibility: The code must be eligible for this event. Preview verifies the member and reward before you confirm fulfillment.
ux.claim.glDisallowed: Guest-list credit is disabled for Member claims. Approval uses 0 guests.
ux.claim.glUnavailable: Guest-list eligibility is unavailable. Guest adjustments are paused; a claim with guests needs the current server rules before approval.
ux.claim.countValidation: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000 for each count.
ux.claim.awardServer: Approval awards XP from the adjusted counts using the current server rules. The server calculates the final award.
ux.claim.rejectRequired: To reject, enter 3–1,000 characters explaining why.
ux.operations.archiveBody: Historical PR reports and payouts are kept here for reference. Use Claim XP for current submissions and reviews.
ux.recap.saved: Saved · editable until HQ locks the recap
ux.recap.fdcPending: FDC data is awaiting its defined source.
ux.recap.saveHint: Save updates the event recap. HQ locking closes editing.
ux.recap.validation: Counts must be whole numbers from 0 to 1,000,000. Revenue must be 0–2,000,000,000. Fill in both responsible staff fields; notes can have up to 2,000 characters.
ux.card.handoverNfcRequired: Handover requires a compatible physical iPhone with NFC and the physical card. Open this task on that device to read and verify the card.
ux.card.encodeNfcRequired: Writing a card requires a compatible physical iPhone with NFC and the physical card. QR or NIM can identify the member but cannot complete the NFC write.
ux.card.identificationOnly: Look up status; physical NFC is still required for handover.
ux.card.repairReplaceGuide: Chip responds and card is present: repair encoding with HQ approval. Card lost or chip does not respond: replace the card and permanently invalidate the old card.
ux.card.chipQuestion: Is the card present and does its chip respond?
ux.card.replaceConsequences: Permanent action: the old card token and UID will be refused. A replacement enters the print queue with the applicable replacement fee. Follow up payment in the authorized dashboard.
ux.card.repairConsequences: For a delivered card with a responding chip: request HQ approval for one repair. Only the requester can use the approved grant before its deadline.
ux.card.repairNotAvailable: Request repair from an authorized city account for a delivered card. HQ manages approvals in the dashboard.
ux.card.replacementNext: Replacement card: check the print queue and replacement-fee payment with the member.
ux.card.paymentRefresh: Find this member by NIM in Payments. Return here and refresh the status after recording payment.
ux.reencode.requesterOnly: Only the original requester can perform this repair.
ux.reencode.next.PENDING: Wait for the HQ decision before writing the card.
ux.reencode.next.APPROVED: The requester can repair the physical card once before the deadline.
ux.reencode.next.EXPIRED: This grant cannot be used. Submit a new request if the chip still responds.
ux.reencode.next.USED: This grant cannot be reused. Verify the repaired card; request help if it still fails.
ux.reencode.next.REJECTED: Read the HQ decision note before choosing the next action.
ux.encode.stageVerify: 2 · Verify the member and card before writing
ux.encode.reportOnly: The physical write has completed. Retry only the server report; do not write the card again.
ux.recap.lockConfirm: Lock the saved version of this event recap? Editing will be closed. Save or discard your changes before locking.
ux.claim.reasonTooLong: The rejection reason can have up to 1,000 characters.
ux.reencode.deadlineUnavailable: The grant deadline is unavailable. Refresh the status or ask HQ before repairing.
ux.social.staffContext: You can read community channels available to your account. Personal reservations and visiting-city requests need an active membership. Turn on Admin mode in Account for authorized crew tasks.
ux.social.adminModeRequired: This crew task needs Admin mode. Turn it on in Account to continue.
ux.social.roamingUnavailable: This event is not eligible for visiting-city access. It may be in your home city, ended, or no longer available. Choose another event explicitly to continue.
ux.social.noVisitingEventsBody: There are no upcoming events outside your home city. Your original event has not been replaced.
ux.social.noReservationsBody: Reservations for this context will appear here with confirmation and deposit status.
ux.social.noMatchesBody: Change the search or filters to see more records.
ux.social.reservationDecision: Update the reservation for {member} at {event}, slot {slot}?
ux.social.depositAfterConfirmation: The crew must confirm this reservation before recording a deposit.
ux.social.depositNextStep: Arrange the deposit with the crew in chat. An unpaid reservation can block your next booking until the crew records payment.
ux.social.depositChat: Ask the crew about confirmation or deposit
ux.social.receivedOutsideApp: Record only a deposit already received outside the app. This does not charge the member.
ux.social.invalidAmount: Enter a whole rupiah amount from Rp 1 to Rp 2,000,000,000.
ux.social.depositConfirm: Confirm {amount} has been received from {member} for {event}, slot {slot}. This records the deposit and clears this reservation's unpaid booking block.
ux.social.noRoamingBody: Attendance and community access requests will appear here. Each request keeps its event and access type.
ux.social.noMutedBody: Members muted in your authorized cities will appear here.
ux.social.noScreenshotsBody: Screenshot records from community channels will appear here when reported.
ux.social.staffHubUnavailable: Community access is unavailable for this staff account
ux.mode.title: Admin mode
ux.mode.body: Show staff workspaces. Your permissions and personal membership stay the same.
ux.mode.finishOperation: Finish the current operation before changing mode or signing out.
ux.mode.noAccessBody: Your account cannot open this workspace.
ux.mode.openTask: This is a staff task. Turn on Admin mode to continue with this task.
ux.otp.sentTo: We sent a six-digit code to {email}.
ux.otp.resent: A new code has been sent. Use the latest email.
ux.welcome.title: Welcome to PATS
ux.welcome.home: Home guides your next event, step by step.
ux.welcome.events: Events shows timing, reservations, and attendance.
ux.welcome.card: Card holds your digital check-in QR and physical KTM status.
ux.welcome.community: Community connects your city and event chats.
ux.welcome.account: Account holds your profile, activity, and preferences.
ux.welcome.staff: Staff access is available from Admin mode near the top of Account. Staff accounts do not need a member profile.
ux.welcome.photoOptional: Optional — you can do this later in Account.
ux.staff.noMembership: Your account has no member profile
ux.staff.noMembershipBody: Personal KTM, XP, reservations, and attendance belong to a member profile. Staff tools are available through Admin mode in Account.
ux.home.title: What should I do now?
ux.home.noEvent: Browse Events for other cities or check back later. Your Card and Account are ready below.
ux.home.chooseEvent: Choose an event to open its staff workspace.
ux.home.scanContext: Choose an open event before scanning.
ux.tools.title: Staff workspaces
ux.tools.eventWorkBody: Open an event for attendance, reservations, claims, rewards, draw, and recap.
ux.tools.webHqBody: Use the HQ web dashboard for approvals, member administration, cities, payments, and configuration.
ux.tools.webRegionalBody: Use the regional web dashboard for regional member administration, payments, and city settings.
ux.tools.webReturn: The dashboard may ask you to sign in. Return here and refresh after saving.
ux.draw.integrationPending: Staff draw access is awaiting a server update. No draw has been started. Return when the staff draw service is available.
ux.welcome.member: Your home city is {city}. KTM means member card. Show your live digital QR to the crew for check-in; your physical card can still be in preparation.
